c01-bakery-corner.observed_description: A cream two-story corner building at a crossroads with zebra crossings on both streets; its corner windows are full of bread and the door is at the corner.
c01-bakery-corner.note: Usable: a bakery on the corner reads at 180 px and in the 4:5 crop; no writing.

c02-books-corner.observed_description: A red-brick two-story corner building at a crossroads with zebra crossings on both streets; its corner windows are full of colorful books and the door is at the corner.
c02-books-corner.note: Usable: a bookstore on the corner reads at 180 px and in the 4:5 crop; no writing.

c03-police-opposite.observed_description: Seen from a park with a bench and trees, a red-brick police station stands across one street, with a white police car (light bar, blue stripe) parked in front; the car door carries the word POLICE.
c03-police-opposite.note: Usable: the police station opposite the park reads at 180 px; the one word on the car, POLICE, names the place its sentences name and never a wrong option; a v2 without it came out with a white smear on the door.

c04-gas-opposite.observed_description: Seen from a park with a bench and trees, a small gas station (white roof, two pumps, a red car) stands across one street.
c04-gas-opposite.note: Usable: the gas station opposite the park reads at 180 px; pump displays are blank.
